text: 2026-09-17: plan now at revision 4 (docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md). Three fresh-context cold reviews returned revisions 1-3; revision 4 folds every finding. Owner decisions open: A (ADR 0007 Stage D block), C (split and design), D (one bundle per model with composed multi-part films; proposal surface outside the bundle, bound by checksum and receipt -- both recommended), E (does 1.0 ship video recall end to end or only film-capable signatures).
